scope: Recovery integrity fix on an independent branch. Does not replace PR #174, alter its branch, or close #163.
root_causes: A pending destination with the same size was assumed to be this transfer, even if another device wrote different bytes. The queue then reported done and deleted the only local source and ledger row.
Completion ledger write exceptions were logged and swallowed, so cleanup continued without a successful durable write.
File upload success responses were not checked against the expected key and size.
fix: On recovery only, compare local and remote SHA-256 using file/HTTP streams. Require the full expected byte count. Matching content avoids a duplicate; different content is saved under the next available name; verification errors retain the source and ledger for retry.
Require successful ledger writes before fetching, after staging, before sending to a new destination and before completion cleanup. Keep later retry writes runnable after an earlier write fails.
Verify key and size in simple PUT and multipart completion responses for putFile. Invalid receipts produce an error; retry verifies the saved content instead of uploading it twice.
Do not write successful history until the completion ledger write succeeds.
